SELECT s.signalregistry, sp.techsigprob, sp.natsrcprob, sp.sigunique, sp.anomscore,
       sp.techsigprob * (1 - sp.natsrcprob) * sp.sigunique * (0.5 + sp.anomscore/10) as tols_val,
       s.bwhz, s.centerfreqmhz,
       s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000) as bfr
FROM signals s
JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
LIMIT 5;

WITH signal_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.signalregistry,
        sp.techsigprob,
        sp.natsrcprob,
        sp.sigunique,
        sp.anomscore,
        s.bwhz,
        s.centerfreqmhz,
        sp.techsigprob * (1 - sp.natsrcprob) * sp.sigunique * (0.5 + sp.anomscore / 10) AS tols_val,
        s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000) AS bfr
    FROM signals s
    JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
),
classified AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN tols_val < 0.25 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN tols_val < 0.75 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS tols_category
    FROM signal_scores
)
SELECT 
    tols_category AS classification,
    COUNT(*) AS signal_count,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(bfr) AS numeric), 6) AS avg_bfr_measure,
    ROUND(CAST(STDDEV(anomscore) AS numeric), 6) AS stddev_anomaly_metric
FROM classified
GROUP BY tols_category
ORDER BY tols_category;
